alarm_after.en: Good morning! I'm taking the bus into town today.

breakfast.en: Morning! Look outside. It's really cloudy today.
breakfast.tr: Günaydın! Dışarı bak. Bugün hava çok bulutlu.

breakfast.en: Yeah. I'm taking the bus into town later.
The forecast says there's going to be a storm this afternoon.
breakfast.tr: Hava durumu bu öğleden sonra fırtına olacağını söylüyor.

breakfast.en: Really? Then I'll take my umbrella.
breakfast.tr: Gerçekten mi? O zaman şemsiyemi alırım.

breakfast.en: Good idea. And call us if you need anything.
breakfast.tr: İyi fikir. Bir şeye ihtiyacın olursa bizi ara.

review.q: Yesterday I ___ a lost boy at the shop.
review.say: Yesterday I helped a lost boy at the shop.
review.tr: Dün markette kaybolmuş bir çocuğa yardım ettim.

review.q: It's going to rain. You ___ take an umbrella.
review.say: It's going to rain. You should take an umbrella.

review.q: Look at those dark clouds! It ___ rain.
review.say: Look at those dark clouds! It's going to rain.
review.tr: Şu kara bulutlara bak! Yağmur yağacak.

event.en: The sky is getting dark.
The wind is blowing, and it's starting to rain.
Wow, what terrible weather!
Talk about the weather.

choice.prompt: What do you say about the weather?

opts.en: I know! It's really windy, and it's raining hard.
opts.tr: Biliyorum! Çok rüzgarlı ve şiddetli yağmur yağıyor.

opts.en: Yes, it's sunny and hot today.
opts.tr: Evet, bugün hava güneşli ve sıcak.
opts.fb: Look at the sky! It isn't sunny.
Look again. It's raining, not snowing.
opts.fb_tr: Tekrar bak. Kar değil, yağmur yağıyor.

event.en: Good thing the bus is coming soon.
The bus is coming.
Oh no! The bus is making a strange noise.
event.tr: Olamaz! Otobüs garip bir ses çıkarıyor.

event.en: Sorry, everyone! The bus has broken down. The engine isn't working.
event.tr: Herkesten özür dilerim! Otobüs bozuldu. Motor çalışmıyor.

event.en: Ask the driver for help.

choice.prompt: What do you ask the driver?

opts.en: Excuse me, when's the next bus?
opts.tr: Affedersiniz, bir sonraki otobüs ne zaman?

opts.fb: No, you can't! Ask about the next bus.
opts.fb_tr: Hayır, süremezsin! Bir sonraki otobüsü sor.

opts.fb: That doesn't help. Ask the driver about the next bus.
opts.fb_tr: Bu yardımcı olmaz. Şoföre bir sonraki otobüsü sor.

event.en: The next bus is coming in about forty minutes. I'm really sorry.
event.tr: Bir sonraki otobüs yaklaşık kırk dakika sonra geliyor. Gerçekten üzgünüm.

event.en: That's OK. It isn't your fault.
Wait under the bus shelter.
I'm waiting at the bus stop. It's raining really hard.
event.tr: Otobüs durağında bekliyorum. Çok şiddetli yağmur yağıyor.

event.en: Ten minutes later...
This is taking so long. What are you going to do?
event.tr: Bu çok uzun sürüyor. Sen ne yapacaksın?

event.en: Choose what to do.

choice.prompt: What are you going to do?

opts.fb: Hmm, it's very windy and wet. Walking isn't a good idea right now.
opts.fb_tr: Hmm, hava çok rüzgarlı ve ıslak. Şu an yürümek iyi bir fikir değil.

opts.en: I'm going to call a taxi.
opts.fb: There aren't any taxis right now. Try something else.
opts.fb_tr: Şu an hiç taksi yok. Başka bir şey dene.

opts.en: I'm going to call my family.

event.en: I'm calling my family.
Hi! Is everything OK?
Not really. The bus broke down, and it's raining a lot. Can you pick me up?
event.tr: Pek değil. Otobüs bozuldu ve çok yağmur yağıyor. Beni alabilir misin?

event.en: Of course! Stay at the bus stop. I'm coming right now.
event.tr: Tabii ki! Otobüs durağında kal. Hemen geliyorum.

event.en: Thanks! See you soon.
Lucky you! I'm going to call my husband, too.
event.tr: Ne şanslısın! Ben de kocamı arayacağım.

event.en: My family is coming to pick me up.
I'm home again. I'm wet, but I'm safe.

taxi.en: Sorry, all our taxis are busy because of the storm.
taxi.tr: Üzgünüz, fırtına yüzünden bütün taksilerimiz dolu.

couch.en: Come and sit down. You're still wet!

opts.en: The bus broke down in the storm.
The bus breaks down in the storm.
opts.fb: It happened today. Use the past simple: broke down.
opts.fb_tr: Bugün oldu. Geçmiş zaman kullan: broke down.

opts.en: The bus breaked down in the storm.
opts.fb: Break is irregular: broke, not breaked.
opts.fb_tr: Break düzensiz bir fiil: breaked değil, broke.

opts.en: A little, but I was OK.
A little, but I were OK.
opts.fb: With I, we say was: I was OK.
opts.fb_tr: I ile was kullanırız: I was OK.

opts.en: A little, but I am OK yesterday.
opts.fb: Use was for the past: I was OK.
opts.fb_tr: Geçmiş için was kullan: I was OK.

couch.en: You did the right thing. You called us.
Let's have some hot tea. Then it's time for bed.
couch.tr: Biraz sıcak çay içelim. Sonra yatma vakti.

recap: I had breakfast with my family.
I waited for the bus in the storm.

recap_end.en: Broke, waited, called: this is the past simple.
recap_end.tr: Broke, waited, called: bu geçmiş zaman.

quiz.say: It's rainy today. Take an umbrella.

quiz.q: Look at those clouds! It ___ rain.
quiz.say: Look at those clouds! It's going to rain.
Excuse me, when's the next bus?
quiz.tr: Affedersiniz, bir sonraki otobüs ne zaman?

quiz.say: Can you pick me up, please?
Why don't we call a taxi?

quiz_b.q: It's very ___. My umbrella's flying away!
quiz_b.say: It's very windy. My umbrella's flying away!

quiz_b.q: It's cold and white outside. It's ___.
quiz_b.say: It's cold and white outside. It's snowy.
quiz_b.tr: Dışarısı soğuk ve beyaz. Hava karlı.

quiz_b.q: The bus ___ come for forty minutes.
quiz_b.say: The bus won't come for forty minutes.
I'm going to take a taxi.
Are you going to walk home?
Excuse me, is the bus broken?
Could you call my dad, please?

quiz_c.say: I can hear thunder. It's stormy!

quiz_c.q: It's ___ and hot. Let's go to the beach!
quiz_c.say: It's sunny and hot. Let's go to the beach!
quiz_c.tr: Hava güneşli ve sıcak. Hadi plaja gidelim!

quiz_c.q: They ___ going to walk in the rain.
quiz_c.say: They aren't going to walk in the rain.
What are you going to do?

quiz_c.q: Can you help me? Yes, I ___.
quiz_c.say: Can you help me? Yes, I can.
quiz_c.tr: Bana yardım edebilir misin? Evet, edebilirim.

quiz_c.q: How long ___ we have to wait?
quiz_c.say: How long do we have to wait?
Let's not walk. It's too far.
You shouldn't walk in a storm.

Şimdi yatmadan önceki test. On soru.
